title: Talk About Skill Practice

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料；尚待独立教学与发音审核。

instructions: Prepare briefly and record your own response of 120–160 words. The sample is shorter than the 90–120 second target. Add relevant details and allow natural pauses while staying within 120–160 words.
prompt: Speak for about 90–120 seconds, using 120–160 words. Describe a fictional skill you have practiced, a finished event last week, and one piece of feedback you would like. Use at least six lesson words.
reference: I have practiced giving a short welcome message for two months. My objective is to tell a new visitor where to wait and when the meeting begins. On Tuesday last week my tutor listened to my first version and gave me feedback. I changed the order of the information because the room name was difficult to find. I have worked with a mentor since April, and I am more confident when I explain one small duty. At the next session, an apprentice will assist me while the instructor supervises the group. A challenge is making the message useful for people entering through two doors. I would ask for one practical suggestion about how to make the directions clearer. I will keep both versions in my portfolio so I can notice my progress. This is practice, not a promise of employment.
